correctness.rationale: Exact matrix powering yields C^17≡46I mod103 and 46 is nontrivial cube root of 1 mod103; its Teichmüller lift omega makes U=omega^{-1}C^17=I+103D. Each residue-r branch f_r(t)=e1^T C^r U^t v is a convergent restricted analytic Z103 function. Branches r not 0,13,16 remain units. For r13,16, T13=9*103,T16=56*103, and negative zeros at -4,-1 force 103(t+1) times a global unit. For r0, T0=T−17=0,T17=103², divide by 103² and inspect binomial terms mod103; the first surviving quadratic is (omega^{-1}/2)t(t+1). Factoring both distinct roots leaves a global 103-adic unit. This proves all positive indices, including large valuations. Independent arithmetic verified C^17 mod103 and every 1≤n<50000 modulo103^7; bounded truncation does not prove the all-index formula.
residual_risks: Unrestricted p-adic factor theorem is applied to restricted analytic functions, not merely interpolation on sampled indices.
Claim depends on T0=0, T1=T2=1; not a general all-prime theorem.
